name: Globe Visitors Counter
author: vectormapper

sections.description:
Globe Visitors Counter displays a 3D interactive globe with glowing visitor dots and a built-in page counter.
It’s a lightweight alternative to heavy analytics, showing your audience in a clear, visual way.

Features
– Two globe styles: Classic OSM and Land-Cover (switch via shortcode or default in Settings → Globe Visitors Counter).
– Privacy-friendly: no external services or accounts. Visit logs are saved locally in /wp-content/uploads/visitors-lite/.
– No extra tables: data stored as JSON files, safe uninstall.
– Powered by Mapbox GL, with the option to replace the default token.
– Minimal footprint: viewer files live in uploads; the plugin only logs visits.

Use it when you want a visual, shareable globe counter on your site without connecting Google Analytics or third-party trackers.

Usage

Shortcodes:

[visitors_globe_lite]
[visitors_globe_lite skin=”classic”]
[visitors_globe_lite skin=”landcover”]
[visitors_globe_lite title=”VISITORS” width=”100%” height=”600″ skin=”landcover”]

  • skin: classic (default) | landcover
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Add the shortcode to a page: [visitors_globe_lite].
  3. Open the page — the globe is served from /uploads/visitors-lite/index.html; visits are logged to visitors.json.
sections.faq:
Does it collect personal data?

No. It writes only aggregated counters to /uploads/visitors-lite/visitors.json. You can replace the Mapbox token in the viewer files if needed.
